title: MIRROR HEATER
ocr_text:
MIRROR HEATER
Mirror Heater
INSPECTION OF MIRROR HEATER
MEASURE MIRROR HEATER RESISTANCE
Measure the resistance between terminals 1 and 5.
Resistance: 5 — 30 Ω
If resistance value is not correct, replace the mirror.
NOTE: The resistance value is increased according
to the rise of temperature.
